title: Polish UI/UX and visual quality to feel Play Store–ready

requirements.text: Improve the overall UI/UX presentation so the Traffic Jam PWA feels like a high-quality, Play Store–ready app, with consistent styling across the Start/Home screen, Help/About dialogs, Share/Install flows, and in-game HUD (while keeping all user-facing text in English).

quotes: Aap ek kam aur kar do isko itna achcha banaa do ki jaise yah Play store ke upar main usko public Maine karna to yah ek app ke Tarah dikhe iski Koi aapki Tarah look banaa do acchi wali high quality wala

acceptanceCriteria: Start/Home screen, dialogs, and in-game UI share a cohesive visual system (colors, typography, spacing, button styles) with no mismatched component styling.
UI layout is mobile-first and app-like: clear hierarchy, strong primary CTA, consistent padding/margins, and no accidental overflow/scrollbars on common Android viewport sizes.
All user-facing strings shown in the UI remain English-only (no mixed-language labels introduced by the polish pass).

requirements.text: Upgrade visual styling of key interactive elements to feel production-quality: primary/secondary buttons (Play/Download/Share), touch control buttons, dialog surfaces, and HUD elements (score and game-over overlay), including improved states (hover/pressed/disabled/loading) and consistent shadows/borders.

quotes: ...ek app ke Tarah dikhe... acchi wali high quality wala

acceptanceCriteria: Buttons and controls have clear pressed/active/disabled/loading states and meet basic contrast/readability expectations on both light and dark backgrounds.
Touch controls and HUD look intentional and consistent with the rest of the app theme (matching shapes, colors, typography).
No new gameplay behavior is introduced; changes are limited to presentation/styling and UI feedback states.

requirements.text: Add lightweight app-like motion polish (subtle transitions/animations) for screen and dialog interactions (e.g., opening Help/About, Share, Install instructions) and for game state overlays (game over / restart) without impacting game performance on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Dialogs and overlays animate in/out smoothly and consistently (no jarring jumps).
Animations remain subtle and do not reduce readability or interfere with gameplay controls.
No noticeable frame drops are introduced during normal gameplay on mobile due to UI animations.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components must be composed, not edited).
Do not edit immutable hook paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no new backend logic is required for this UI polish request.
nonGoals: Do not change core gameplay rules, physics, steering logic, collision logic, scoring, or obstacle behavior as part of this request.
Do not add third-party auth providers or external services.
Do not add offline gameplay support (the app remains online-only).

preferencesToAdd: Prefer a high-quality, Play Store–ready, app-like visual polish for the Traffic Jam PWA while keeping all user-facing text in English.
